As your company president, I'm inspired by your commitment to our team.
I'm happy to announce that our computer company has won the award for Tech Company of the Year by our city's leading technology magazine.
What a great accomplishment!
Management feels it is time to expand our product line.
As you know, some computer companies produce mobile phones.
Now, I'd like to open the floor to your questions.
Would anyone like to go first?

我很高兴地宣布，我们的电脑公司获得了本市领先科技杂志评选的年度科技公司奖。

管理层认为现在是时候扩大我们的产品线了。
如你们所知，一些电脑公司会生产手机。
现在，我将把发言权交给各位提问。
有没有人想先发言呢？
